name: @stablehand-ext/bugfarm
description: Bugfarm worker: turns a repository's bug-fix history into verified coding tasks, with a live board of every candidate, batch and benchmark cell.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:server
scripts.build:server: esbuild src/main.ts src/sim/cli.ts src/cli/bugfarm.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outdir=dist/server --entry-names=[name] --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && node -e "require('node:fs').cpSync('pipeline/templates','dist/templates',{recursive:true})"
